---
name: Encounter brief does not match the wiki
about: A wave, trigger, NPC or loot line is missing or wrong in a brief, but the wiki page has it right
labels: encounter-data
---

The briefs are built from the EVE University wiki. A brief can go wrong in two places: the wiki page itself, or our
reading of it. Please look at the wiki page first.

- **The wiki is wrong or incomplete:** fix it there (or tell the wiki editors). The fix reaches every Gridwise user at
  the next weekly update, no issue needed here.
- **The wiki is right, the brief is not:** that is ours. Please fill in the rest.

**Site or mission**
<!-- The name as the brief shows it, and the level / faction if there are several. -->

**Wiki page**
<!-- The link to the page on wiki.eveuniversity.org. -->

**What did not come through**
<!-- Which part: a pocket, a wave, a trigger, an NPC (name, count, EWAR), the loot, the notes. -->

**On the wiki**
<!-- Copy the line or table row from the wiki as it is there. -->

**In Gridwise**
<!-- What the brief shows instead, or that it is missing. A screenshot of the brief helps. -->

**Version**
<!-- From Settings → Diagnostics, e.g. "v1.2.1 · …" -->
